input.account: The footbridge reopened after the three replacement boards were fitted.

result.title: Footbridge Repair Restores Access but Alters Neighborhood Quiet
result.finding: The replacement of the footbridge boards has reopened a vital path for residents, yet the new wood creaks differently underfoot, subtly changing the neighborhood's familiar quiet. This tradeoff between safety and ambiance lingers unnoticed by many.
